title: Volume 1 Chapter 9: I Want to Know Love 1
content: Two years ago, I, Krush, turned sixteen and witnessed Lady Rana's appointment as the housekeeper.
Until then, my life had been a desperate struggle for survival, living disguised as a boy with my short hair.
The Corias Territory, with its stark disparities and sprawling slums, was certainly not a good place.
It was a rural area that truly deserved the term "frontier," having made little progress.
However, for the nobles and those who came from elsewhere, it might have been a fine town.
The Adventurers Guild and inns were plentiful.
But for those who lived here, especially the residents of the slums, nothing was returned to them.
Count Korias, the lord, resided in the Royal Capital and only performed the bare minimum of governance.
The common folk were merely oppressed by merchants and the wealthy, leading to a high crime rate due to the growing disparities.
Yet, a savior appeared.

The First Knight Order, which had been acting freely, was dispatched to the Royal Capital as the lord's guards, while the knights of the Second and Third Knight Orders, who had been oppressing the citizens alongside the merchants, were assigned to guard the borders and territories, giving them a proper role as knights.
The newly established Fourth Knight Order began to eradicate the crimes that had spread throughout the Corias Territory, such as corruption and embezzlement.
Yes, this was all part of Lady Rana's policies, which she pushed forward with the Fourth Knight Order, suppressing much opposition.
Despite the significant backlash from merchants and knights, Lady Rana accomplished her goals.
She created the first all-female knight order in Corias history, which became a source of hope for the women who felt the disparities most acutely.
Can you believe it?
In my childhood, I rummaged through garbage, and there were many dangerous incidents where I had to disguise myself as a boy to stay safe, with slave traders keeping a watchful eye.
A society that favored only men.
That was about to change.
Lady Rana established the Fourth Knight Order as an all-female knight order to bring about that change.
Moreover, she recruited not only those living in the slums but also orphans without discrimination.
I was just a typical woman from the slums with nothing to my name.
At first, I couldn't even speak properly or wield a sword. I must have been a foul-mouthed, ill-tempered brat.
You are desperate to survive, aren't you?
But from now on, women will create society, demonstrate strength, and support the territory.
Will you join us?
Lady Rana said she needed me. Living in the slums, I was not seen as a person. Yet, Lady Rana saw me as an individual.
So, I decided to become Lady Rana's sword.
To live as a sword, I learned etiquette, trained in swordsmanship, and worked harder than anyone else.
However, the most necessary attribute was something I lacked.
I can't express how much despair I felt about myself.
Even so, Lady Freina told me,
Krush, there is no one who has worked harder than you to blossom their sword talent.
I am proud of you.
Even if you have no attribute, you are someone to be proud of as the vice-captain of the Fourth Knight Order.
You are already a wonderful person as you are.
Those words have supported me to this day. When Lady Rana was in danger, I was able to willingly offer my life.
Even against the White King, I was able to challenge the undead, knowing my sword was no match for him.
Lady Rana said she needed me. Lady Freina said she was proud of me.
Facing the White King, I felt I could die here without regret.
For the sake of those two important people, I would not hesitate to give my life.
I had made up my mind. Yet, I was saved by Lord Salt.
Following the chivalry spirit that Lady Freina taught me, I wanted to repay Lord Salt's kindness.
However, more than that, Lady Rana and Lady Freina said they needed Lord Salt.
To have Lord Salt, whom the two sought, join us, I would also lend my support.
Yet, as I interacted with Lord Salt, I began to feel confused about my own changes.
I had no attribute and could not use magic.
I had always harbored anxiety about whether I was truly suited to be the vice-captain of the Fourth Knight Order.
Thus, I honed my swordsmanship and proved my strength as the vice-captain of the knight order.
I believed that was the only thing I could do.
However, after meeting Lord Salt, I gradually became aware of the changes around me.
Since Lady Rana began receiving his treatment, I felt her male phobia had improved, and her expression had softened.
Lady Rana was usually strict and took a resolute stance toward everyone.
However, in front of men, she would tremble and show signs of fear.
Yet, when she spoke to Lord Salt, she wore a gentle smile.
And that warmth began to spread to the other members of the order.
I was bewildered as I witnessed my comrades in the knight order opening their hearts to Lord Salt and developing feelings for him.
I didn't quite understand what
"affection
" meant.
Every time I saw the other members talking about Lord Salt with joy and relying on him, I felt something stirring in my chest.
I couldn't grasp what that feeling was, so I could only watch from the sidelines.
To them, Lord Salt was becoming an indispensable presence in the knight order, a precious person.
I understood that logically, but I couldn't name that feeling within me.
Amidst all this, I began to act as Lord Salt's personal knight.
Under the pretense of being his bodyguard, I stayed by his side, and little by little, I began to understand his character.
He was kind, strong, and never boasted about himself.
With each of his actions, I felt something within me changing bit by bit.
The moment I became fully aware of it was during an incident in the village.
When the girls risked themselves for me, I first thought their courage was noble and patted their heads.
In that moment, I felt something warm spreading deep within my heart.
Could that have been the
"love
" that everyone felt?
I wanted to protect them, and I found Lord Salt's back, who protected us, to be precious.
I wanted to protect him as a knight.
And I began to wish to fight by the side of Lord Salt, who had protected me.
"Is this love?"
I still honestly didn't know.
I tried to think about it slowly once more, but I still couldn't understand.
I could certainly feel something sprouting within me, but I couldn't clearly articulate what it was.
However, I noticed that being with him was gradually changing my heart.
The feeling of joy I had about that was also an emotion I couldn't fully comprehend.
As the battle against the Dragon Zombie approached, Lord Salt taught me about the possibilities of having no attribute.
"There are things you can do precisely because you have no attribute. You have that power."
No one had ever told me such things. And I had been the one to put a lid on my own potential.
He believed in me.
No, Lady Rana, Lady Freina, May, and all the members of the Fourth Knight Order had always believed in me.
It was I who had been pretending not to notice that.
Lord Salt's words shook my heart strongly.
Until now, I had always felt a complex about my lack of attribute. He showed me new possibilities with that attribute.
It felt as if he had affirmed my existence, and I could feel something warm spreading within my chest.
Then, during the battle with the Dragon Zombie, I felt exhilaration and fear for the first time.
As Lord Salt began to chant to use magic, the Dragon Zombie rose and moved to kill him with its massive body.
In that dangerous situation, when I thought he might die, I was struck by a sensation that tightened around my heart.
Could he really die like this?
In that moment, the emotion surging within me was fear.
A strong rejection of losing him!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/ao18jdE.jpeg
At that moment, I clearly realized that I held a special place for Lord Salt in my heart.
He had become an irreplaceable presence for me.
Having struggled with my lack of attribute and not understanding others' feelings, he had shown me a new world.
And by walking alongside him, I had been able to change little by little.
What he taught me was not just power, but heart.
In this moment, I felt I could finally name the feelings that had been sprouting within me.
I didn't know if it was love.
But the desire to protect him, the wish not to lose him.
That felt like the most important emotion to me now.
Krush, you don't lack an attribute.
You have an attribute that only you possess.
So be proud.
Your lack of attribute is strong.
Lord Salt's voice resonated in my heart, and my body moved naturally.
Until now, everyone had thought of a lack of attribute as being unable to use magic.
No one had ever told me that a lack of attribute could be strong.
There was someone who called it pride.
But no one had ever told me it was okay to take pride in it.
People looked at me like I was a delicate object, and even after becoming the vice-captain of the Fourth Knight Order, many looked down on me because of my lack of attribute.
I didn't know how to respond to Lord Salt, who denied all of that.
"Lord Salt."
"Yes?"
"You are a strange man."
"Is that so?"
"Yes, telling me to take pride in my lack of attribute..."
I couldn't say anything more.
"I am your personal knight! I will protect you!"
Even in front of the Dragon Zombie, I felt no fear.
Compared to losing him, I could easily deflect the Dragon Zombie's claws.
There had never been a battle that made me feel so proud and exhilarated!
The battle with the Dragon Zombie had ended.
Silence enveloped the area, and the miasma that had been raging began to dissipate.
Finally, we had achieved victory.
The miasma that had been so suffocating was nowhere to be felt.
This was Lord Salt's power.
I could understand why Lady Rana and Lady Freina acknowledged Lord Salt's abilities.
And I also understood the feelings of cherishing his existence.
Breathing heavily, Lord Salt, who had defeated the Dragon Zombie, was panting and taking deep breaths.
I could see that his clothes were torn in places and blood was seeping from his wounds.
The moment I saw that, something hot surged within my chest.
"Lord Salt, are you okay?"
I rushed over to him and called out.
However, the moment he saw me, his eyes widened, and his face turned bright red as he froze.
"K-Krush... um... your... clothes..."
He said in a thin voice, turning his gaze away.
He must have realized that my clothes were torn and my skin was exposed.
Unable to bear the embarrassment, he fainted.
Seeing him like that made my heart tighten.
Despite having overcome such a fierce battle, he was still embarrassed by my exposure.
What a pure and... wonderful person he is.
"Really, you are..."
I gently pulled his head close and placed it on my lap.
This was the second time I had given him a lap pillow.
But back then, I hadn't thought much of it; I was just concerned that the carriage would be bumpy and uncomfortable for him.
However, now I found it endearing to have his head resting on my lap.
I felt my heart gently filled with warmth from the heat radiating from his head.
He had protected us many times before. He purified the miasma, defeated the Dragon Zombie, and fought for everyone.
Feeling his breathing calm, I placed my hand on his head and gently stroked his hair.
Sweat glistened on his forehead, and fatigue was deeply etched on his face.
Yet, I now clearly understood how significant his presence was to me.
"You are truly an amazing person..."
I murmured, knowing he couldn't hear me.
How many people in this world can defeat a Dragon Zombie? His power is indeed immeasurable.
But he couldn't fight alone.
He had a side that couldn't be left alone.
That kindness also enveloped us.
That's why I...
Driven by that thought, I suddenly lowered my face and brought my lips close to his forehead.
And gently kissed him.
It was something I could only do now, while he was unconscious.
But this feeling was genuine. Even if he was Lady Rana's beloved.
"Even if you are Lady Rana's beloved, I will follow you as your personal knight, no matter where."
I quietly made that vow.
Gently stroking his head, I once again realized how deeply I was drawn to him.
After defeating the Dragon Zombie, we finally returned to the castle of Corias.
Having overcome that fierce battle alongside Lord Salt, a new emotion had been born within me.
Now, I could understand the words Lady Freina and May had tried to convey to me.
Yes, what I felt at that moment, that fluttering in my chest... it was "love."
The moment I realized I felt "love" for Lord Salt, I simultaneously became aware of Lady Rana's feelings as well.
I understood that Lady Rana's feelings for Lord Salt were also "love."
Such a wise and beautiful person.
I thought I should keep this feeling to myself and step back.
"I could never compete with Lady Rana for his affection..."
In the lively castle after our return, I told myself that alone.
Yet, the feelings I had buried deep within me continued to swell.
I couldn't do anything about this feeling.
But I thought it should remain only within me.
At that moment, Lady Rana called out to me.
"Krush, I would like to talk to you for a moment, if that's alright?"
I was surprised by her sudden words and instinctively straightened my back.
"...Yes, Lady Rana."
Her voice was as gentle as always, but there seemed to be a determination in her eyes.
I followed Lady Rana as she led me to a small salon in a corner of her office.
Lady Rana offered me a chair and sat down beside me. Then, she slowly opened her mouth.
Krush, thank you so much for returning safely with Lord Salt.
I can't express how happy it makes me to know you are safe...
With those words, Lady Rana embraced me tightly.
She truly is a wonderful person. She accepts me wholeheartedly.
As her words warmed my heart, I also sensed that I could guess what the conversation that would follow might be about.
"And, Krush... I am aware of your special feelings for Lord Salt..."
My heart raced. I couldn't say anything in response to Lady Rana's words and could only avert my gaze from her.
"Don't worry, I'm not here to blame you. I just want to tell you something."
Lady Rana continued with a smile.
Hearing that she wasn't going to blame me brought me relief, and I looked into her eyes.
"I think I have fallen in love with Lord Salt. To be honest, I don't quite understand it myself."
"Eh? Lady Rana doesn't understand it either?"
"Fufu, that's right. After all, this must be my first love too. You feel the same way, don't you?"
I don't know if this feeling is 'love.' However, I do have the desire to protect Lord Salt as a knight.
And I want to be by his side.
"I see. I feel the same way."
"Lady Rana feels the same?"
Yes, that's right.
But as a noble, I have no intention of monopolizing him in this dangerous world.
Lord Salt possesses incredible power and is sought after by many women.
I felt a sharp pain in my chest at Lady Rana's words.
The thought of Lord Salt being sought after by other women caused a slight ache in my heart.
I can't imagine him belonging to just one woman.
Rather, I believe he should be loved by many women and leave behind descendants.
I opened my eyes wide at those words. I never expected Lady Rana to think such things.
However, there was certainly logic to her words.
In this world, it was natural for those with power to leave behind many descendants.
Moreover, for Lady Rana to voice such thoughts...
"...Lady Rana, are you not interested in any men other than Lord Salt?"
At my question, Lady Rana nodded quietly.
Yes.
To be honest, I still find the gazes from men other than Lord Salt frightening.
My male phobia still lingers.
He is the only one who brings me peace of mind.
I was surprised by Lady Rana's words.
She seemed to have overcome her male phobia, but in reality, she had not completely healed.
Even so, Lord Salt was different. To Lady Rana, he had become a special presence.
"I see..."
I murmured softly.
I had also realized that I had no interest in any men other than Lord Salt.
I felt once again that he was my one and only.
"Krush, aren't you the same?"
At Lady Rana's question, I hesitated for a moment but eventually nodded honestly.
"...Yes. I have no interest in any men other than Lord Salt. He is the only one who resonates with my heart."
Lady Rana smiled gently upon hearing my words. Then, she softly grasped my hand.
"That's perfectly fine, Krush. I take pride in us both loving the same person. You also care for Lord Salt, don't you?"
"...Yes. I take pride in having fallen for the same person as Lady Rana."
I felt my heart lighten at Lady Rana's words.
She too held the same feelings as I did.
Thinking that brought an inexplicable joy.
"Fufu, since we’re at it, why don’t we share the good things about Lord Salt with each other?"
Lady Rana suggested with a smile. I was surprised by her words, but I gradually felt my cheeks relax.
"That sounds... nice."
We exchanged glances and laughed together.
Then, we began to talk about Lord Salt's good qualities—his kindness, strength, and purity...
As we spoke, our hearts grew warmer and warmer.
I thought that this time spent with Lady Rana, sharing our feelings for Lord Salt and discussing his good traits, was the happiest moment of all.
